summary: 2. The Petitioner, aggrieved by the Commission’s order dated 6.5.2015, filed Review Petition No. 12/RP/2015 in Petition No. 229/2010. The Commission, vide order dated 27.6.2016, while disposing of the said Review Petition, observed as under: _14. Petition No. 12/RP/2015 is disposed of in terms of the above. Petition No. 437/GT2014 shall be listed for hearing on 28.7.2016.”_ 4. An Appeal No. 204 of 2016 was filed by the Petitioner before the Appellate Tribunal for Electricity (APTEL), challenging the order dated 6.5.2015 passed by the Commission in Petition No. 229 of 2010 on the following grounds: _Order in Petition No. 229/2010 (on Remand from APTEL) Page_ _**2** of_ **26** _28. Accordingly, the case is now remanded back to the Commission for determining the timelines for the power project afresh in terms of this judgment after hearing the_ _Order in Petition No. 229/2010 (on Remand from APTEL) Page_ _**3** of_ **26** _parties again. The Commission shall endeavour to pass the fresh order expeditiously and not later than four months from the date of the judgment.”_ 6. Pursuant to APTEL order dated 22.7.2025, the matter was heard on 14.10.2025. The learned counsel for the petitioner referred to the APTEL judgment dated 22.7.2025, and requested a fresh determination of the project timelines, after hearing the parties in accordance with the said judgment. She further submitted that once the Scheduled Commercial Operation Date (SCOD) of the Project is determined, the other reliefs sought by the Petitioner, being consequential thereto, may also be considered, and requested time to place on record certain additional documents in the matter. The Commission permitted the Petitioner to submit said additional information, and the parties were directed to file their written submissions. In compliance, the Petitioner has filed its written submissions. 7. The Petitioner, vide its affidavit dated 2.12.2025, has submitted the following: _Order in Petition No. 229/2010 (on Remand from APTEL) Page_ _**4** of_ **26** _Order in Petition No. 229/2010 (on Remand from APTEL) Page_ _**5** of_ **26** _Order in Petition No. 229/2010 (on Remand from APTEL) Page_ _**6** of_ **26** _Order in Petition No. 229/2010 (on Remand from APTEL) Page_ _**7** of_ **26** _Order in Petition No. 229/2010 (on Remand from APTEL) Page_ _**8** of_ **26** _Order in Petition No. 229/2010 (on Remand from APTEL) Page_ _**9** of_ **26** 8. She also prayed that the matter may be reserved for orders. The Commission, after granting the last opportunity to the Respondents, reserved its order in this matter. However, no reply has been received in the matter. 13.
